name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 68 – Am 16
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 68b. Stresses the need to significantly boost start-ups, scale-ups and SMEs in the sector as a priority and a structural element of the single market for defence section of the white paper; stresses that, for well-established or systemic actors in the defence sector, public investment should be accompanied by additional safeguards to ensure that public money is reinvested and not used for the purpose of generating profits for their shareholders, such as by windfall profit taxes;
